FROM 
D360.STG_EDS_LNS_LASHDLBALANCE WHERE H = 'D'

scripts.text:
TRUNCATE TABLE d360.STG_EDS_LNS_LASHDLBALANCE_SELECT_SRC;

INSERT INTO d360.STG_EDS_LNS_LASHDLBALANCE_SELECT_SRC
(
				 BANK_ID
				,REST_FLG
				,INSTALLMENT_FLG
				,TS_CNT
				,RCRE_TIME
				,RCRE_USER_ID
				,LCHG_TIME
				,LCHG_USER_ID
				,SBHT_SET_NUM
				,AS_ON_DATE
				,INTEREST_AMOUNT
				,SHDL_BALANCE
				,END_DATE
				,START_DATE
				,SRL_NUM
				,ACID
				,[FILE_NAME]
				,JSRC_FLG 
				,JTAR_FLG 
)
SELECT 
				 BANK_ID
				,REST_FLG
				,INSTALLMENT_FLG
				,TS_CNT
				,RCRE_TIME
				,RCRE_USER_ID
				,LCHG_TIME
				,LCHG_USER_ID
				,SBHT_SET_NUM
				,AS_ON_DATE
				,INTEREST_AMOUNT
				,SHDL_BALANCE
				,END_DATE
				,START_DATE
				,SRL_NUM
				,ACID
				,[FILE_NAME]
				,1 AS JSRC_FLG 
				,0 AS JTAR_FLG 
			FROM [d360].[STG_EDS_LNS_LASHDLBALANCE]
            WHERE H = 'D';


INSERT INTO d360.STG_EDS_LNS_LASHDLBALANCE_SELECT_SRC
(
				 BANK_ID
				,REST_FLG
				,INSTALLMENT_FLG
				,TS_CNT
				,RCRE_TIME
				,RCRE_USER_ID
				,LCHG_TIME
				,LCHG_USER_ID
				,SBHT_SET_NUM
				,AS_ON_DATE
				,INTEREST_AMOUNT
				,SHDL_BALANCE
				,END_DATE
				,START_DATE
				,SRL_NUM
				,ACID
				,[FILE_NAME]
				,JSRC_FLG 
				,JTAR_FLG 
)
			SELECT 				
				 CC.BANK_ID
				,CC.REST_FLG
				,CC.INSTALLMENT_FLG
				,CC.TS_CNT
				,CC.RCRE_TIME
				,CC.RCRE_USER_ID
				,CC.LCHG_TIME
				,CC.LCHG_USER_ID
				,CC.SBHT_SET_NUM
				,CC.AS_ON_DATE
				,CC.INTEREST_AMOUNT
				,CC.SHDL_BALANCE
				,CC.END_DATE
				,CC.START_DATE
				,CC.SRL_NUM
				,CC.ACID
				,CC.[FILE_NAME]
		        ,0 AS JSRC_FLG 
				,1 AS JTAR_FLG 
			FROM EDS.LNS_LASHDLBALANCE CC
			JOIN d360.STG_EDS_LNS_LASHDLBALANCE B 
            ON CC.ACID = B.ACID
			AND CC.SRL_NUM = B.SRL_NUM
			AND CC.BANK_ID = B.BANK_ID
			WHERE CC.ISLATEST = '1';


TRUNCATE TABLE d360.STG_EDS_LNS_LASHDLBALANCE_GROUP_SRC;

INSERT INTO d360.STG_EDS_LNS_LASHDLBALANCE_GROUP_SRC
(
				 BANK_ID
				,REST_FLG
				,INSTALLMENT_FLG
				,TS_CNT
				,RCRE_TIME
				,RCRE_USER_ID
				,LCHG_TIME
				,LCHG_USER_ID
				,SBHT_SET_NUM
				,AS_ON_DATE
				,INTEREST_AMOUNT
				,SHDL_BALANCE
				,END_DATE
				,START_DATE
				,SRL_NUM
				,ACID
				,[FILE_NAME]
				,JSRC_FLG_CNT 
				,JTAR_FLG_CNT 
				,FILE_DATE
)

select 
				 BANK_ID
				,REST_FLG
				,INSTALLMENT_FLG
				,TS_CNT
				,RCRE_TIME
				,RCRE_USER_ID
				,LCHG_TIME
				,LCHG_USER_ID
				,SBHT_SET_NUM
				,AS_ON_DATE
				,INTEREST_AMOUNT
				,SHDL_BALANCE
				,END_DATE
				,START_DATE
				,SRL_NUM
				,ACID
				,[FILE_NAME]
				,JSRC_FLG_CNT 
				,JTAR_FLG_CNT
				,CAST(LEFT(RIGHT(FILE_NAME , 12), 8) AS DATE) FILE_DATE
from 
(
	SELECT 				
				 BANK_ID
				,REST_FLG
				,INSTALLMENT_FLG
				,TS_CNT
				,RCRE_TIME
				,RCRE_USER_ID
				,LCHG_TIME
				,LCHG_USER_ID
				,SBHT_SET_NUM
				,AS_ON_DATE
				,INTEREST_AMOUNT
				,SHDL_BALANCE
				,END_DATE
				,START_DATE
				,SRL_NUM
				,ACID
				,MAX(FILE_NAME) FILE_NAME 
				,SUM(JSRC_FLG) AS JSRC_FLG_CNT 
				,SUM(JTAR_FLG) AS JTAR_FLG_CNT
	FROM d360.STG_EDS_LNS_LASHDLBALANCE_SELECT_SRC
	GROUP BY     				 
				 BANK_ID
				,REST_FLG
				,INSTALLMENT_FLG
				,TS_CNT
				,RCRE_TIME
				,RCRE_USER_ID
				,LCHG_TIME
				,LCHG_USER_ID
				,SBHT_SET_NUM
				,AS_ON_DATE
				,INTEREST_AMOUNT
				,SHDL_BALANCE
				,END_DATE
				,START_DATE
				,SRL_NUM
				,ACID
	HAVING ( SUM(JSRC_FLG) > 0 AND SUM(JTAR_FLG) = 0 ) OR ( SUM(JSRC_FLG) = 0 AND SUM(JTAR_FLG) = 1) 
) AS TEMP


UPDATE A
SET
SCD_END_DATE = dateadd(dd,-1,@DatetoProcessed)
, ISLATEST = 0
FROM EDS.LNS_LASHDLBALANCE A 
INNER JOIN d360.STG_EDS_LNS_LASHDLBALANCE_GROUP_SRC B 
ON COALESCE(A.ACID,'-1') = COALESCE(B.ACID,'-1')
AND COALESCE(A.SRL_NUM,'-1') = COALESCE(B.SRL_NUM,'-1')
AND COALESCE(A.BANK_ID,'-1') = COALESCE(B.BANK_ID,'-1')
AND A.ISLATEST = 1
AND B.JTAR_FLG_CNT = 1




INSERT INTO EDS.LNS_LASHDLBALANCE
(
				 BANK_ID
				,REST_FLG
				,INSTALLMENT_FLG
				,TS_CNT
				,RCRE_TIME
				,RCRE_USER_ID
				,LCHG_TIME
				,LCHG_USER_ID
				,SBHT_SET_NUM
				,AS_ON_DATE
				,INTEREST_AMOUNT
				,SHDL_BALANCE
				,END_DATE
				,START_DATE
				,SRL_NUM
				,ACID
				,SCD_START_DATE 
				,SCD_END_DATE
				,ISACTIVE
				,ISLATEST
				,BNK_CODE
				,SOURCE_CODE 
				,FILE_NAME 
				,insert_dttm
)
SELECT
				 BANK_ID
				,REST_FLG
				,INSTALLMENT_FLG
				,TS_CNT
				,RCRE_TIME
				,RCRE_USER_ID
				,LCHG_TIME
				,LCHG_USER_ID
				,SBHT_SET_NUM
				,AS_ON_DATE
				,INTEREST_AMOUNT
				,SHDL_BALANCE
				,END_DATE
				,START_DATE
				,SRL_NUM
				,ACID
				,FILE_DATE
				,'9999-12-31'
				,1
				,1
				,LEFT(SRC.FILE_NAME,5)
				,'LNS'
				,SRC.FILE_NAME
				,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
FROM d360.STG_EDS_LNS_LASHDLBALANCE_GROUP_SRC SRC
WHERE JSRC_FLG_CNT > 0
